== Summary ==
Slip “Eyes In The Dark” cut unchanged from page 5 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (68, 955, 581, 1239)). Version [[Eyes In The Dark (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
